title: Embassy of India, Kathmandu — assistance for Indian nationals
body: The Embassy of India in Kathmandu is coordinating with Nepalese authorities on search and rescue for Indian nationals affected by flash floods in the Rasuwa / Bhotekoshi area. Indian nationals and families may also contact the MEA Special Control Room in Delhi: +91-11-23088718, +91-11-23088719, WhatsApp +91-9968291988, email situationroom@mea.gov.in. Embassy WhatsApp: +977-9851316807.
